summary.text: Improve the scan by uncovering your face, keeping still, and using suitable lighting and camera quality.

steps.name: Uncover your face
steps.text: Make sure your face is not covered during the scan.

steps.name: Keep still
steps.text: Do not move while scanning is in progress.

steps.name: Check the room
steps.text: Use an environment that is not too dark.

steps.name: Check the background
steps.text: Make sure there is no strong lighting in the background.

steps.name: Use a better camera
steps.text: Use a camera with a minimum resolution of two megapixels. If you are using a laptop, try again using a mobile phone which has a better camera.

steps.name: Contact Singpass
steps.text: If you still need help, contact the Singpass Helpdesk directly.

example_phrasings: Why is Singpass Face Verification failing for me?
Why does Singpass face checking fail?
How can I get face verification to work?

sources.page_title: Why is Singpass Face Verification failing for me?

quotes.text: There may be several possible reasons for this.
You keep still while scanning is in progress
Your environment is not too dark
There is no strong lighting in the background
You use a minimum resolution of two megapixels for the camera.
If you require assistance with Singpass Face Verification, please contact the Singpass Helpdesk directly.
